vaultSummary: Basic campaign revenue report with Sales Reps

fields.label: Campaign ID
fields.description: Campaign Identifier

fields.label: Current Rep ID
fields.description: Current Rep Identifier

fields.label: Current Rep Pct
fields.description: Current Rep Percentage.  There can be multiple reps on an order with each earning a different percent of the order towards commission.

fields.label: Line ID
fields.description: Line Identifier.  Campaigns will have multiple lines and lines will have multiple line details

fields.label: Month Actual Amt
fields.description: Used to calculate the Net/Gross amounts

fields.label: Month Est Amt
fields.description: Used to calculate the Net/Gross amounts.

fields.label: Month End Date
fields.description: The ending date of the Order details record.

fields.label: Month Start Date
fields.description: The starting date of the Order details record.

fields.label: No Agy Comm Ind
fields.description:
Can be considered the Issue date for a Print publication. 
The starting date of the Order details record.

fields.label: Product ID
fields.description:
Product Identifier
For a digital ad, this can be considered a Web Site ID.  The location of the detail is in the AD Publications mapping.

fields.label: Print Pub Ind
fields.description:
Y = Print publication
N = Digital Publication

fields.label: Product
fields.description: Product Name

fields.label: Campaign Date Entered
fields.description: Date that the campaign was entered into the system.

fields.label: Campaign Type
fields.description:
M = Performance Campaign
F = Flexible Campaign

fields.label: Campaign Status Code
fields.description:
Only these status' are included in results
IS = Invoice Started
CO = Confirmed
R* = Reserved (can have multiple codes R1, R2, etc)

fields.label: Gross Line Local Amount
fields.description: Total Gross Revenue (including Agency Commission) in local currency

fields.label: Gross Line Foreign Amount
fields.description: Total Gross Foreign Revenue (including Agency Commission) in foreign currency

fields.label: Net Line Foreign Amount
fields.description: Total Net Foreign Revenue (excluding Agency Commission) in foreign currency

fields.label: Net Line Local Amount
fields.description: Total Net Revenue (excluding Agency Commission) in local currency

fields.label: Net Rep Foreign Amount
fields.description: Total Net Foreign Revenue (excluding Agency Commission) in foreign currency and multiplied by the rep percentage

fields.label: Net Rep Local Amount
fields.description: Total Net Revenue (excluding Agency Commission) in local currency and multiplied by the rep percentage

fields.label: Cur Rep Name
fields.description: Current Rep Name

fields.label: Agency Commission Percent
fields.description: Used to calculate Net and Gross Revenue.  Indicates the agency commission percent

fields.label: Currency Code
fields.description: What the foreign currency code is.

fields.label: Currency Exchange Rate
fields.description: Exchange rate for the foreign currency stored on the AD Internet Campaign mapping.
